TABLE.NAME: local_eftimeclock_session
TABLE.COMMENT: Active time (seconds) per user and activity. Same schema as the PRO suite, so a migration loses nothing.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: course_module id (the free plugin only measures activities).

FIELD.NAME: duration
FIELD.COMMENT: Active seconds of the visit (cumulative, bounded by the server clock).

FIELD.NAME: clienttoken
FIELD.COMMENT: Visit token generated by the client. It makes the save idempotent: every send of the same visit updates the same row, even when the browser gets no answer (sendBeacon).

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last save of the visit: the reference the next save of this user is bounded by.

TABLE.NAME: local_eftimeclock_cfg
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course settings of the free clock (a course without a row follows the site values).

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = time is measured and the clock shown; 0 = off.

FIELD.NAME: clocktheme
FIELD.COMMENT: Clock theme (closed list; the free plugin offers zafiro and pizarra).
